corpus.sources: current Clay/FRANK/ClayCode/UnifiedDB/GWT/Hyperposition/Emergenz/ClayGraph concepts as frozen for this run
corpus.gold: manually declared mechanism sets per question
corpus.warning: not a blind production retrieval corpus

arms.name: explicit_only
arms.mechanism: query lexical relevance only; no prior activation

arms.name: truthful_prior
arms.mechanism: same query + prior event/continuity seed propagated locally before scoring

arms.name: shuffled_prior
arms.mechanism: same query + deliberately wrong shifted prior seed

remote_replication.comparison_scope: same self-use subset and summary metrics

interpretation: On this small staged current-RAE graph, truthful continuity adds retrieval value beyond the lexical path, while shuffled prior does not reproduce the MRR/recall gain. This supports testing truthful activation as an associative prior, not a universal retrieval replacement.
limitations: same researcher constructed corpus and mechanism
decision_effect: Unlike Cycle 4, this cycle has an executable self-use mechanism test. It is sufficient to refine the candidate to route-selective activation, but insufficient for graph promotion.
